facts.business: Jujhar Logistics Limited (formerly CDG Petchem Limited) is engaged in the transportation and logistics business, specifically car carrier operations, and holds a 51% stake in subsidiary Jujhar Logistic and Travels Limited.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of 51% stake in Jujhar Logistic and Travels Limited

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Board expects the consolidated results for FY 2026-27 to be the first meaningful indication of the scale and profitability of the logistics business.
guidance_or_targets.value: First meaningful indication of scale and profitability

auditor.name: Rajesh Mehru & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualification under CARO 2020 clause (vii) regarding disputed statutory dues of Rs. 4.43 Lakh for AY 2018-19 pending before Assessing Officer; charge satisfaction of Rs. 7 crore with ICICI Bank not recorded with ROC.

key_risks: Transition risk from change in business nature and dependence on subsidiary performance
Goodwill impairment risk of Rs. 1,272.47 Lakh on consolidation
Unfunded gratuity obligation of Rs. 111.91 Lakh
Cyber security and IT system disruption risk
Credit and receivable risk with aged receivables from discontinued chemicals business
Customer concentration risk with few automotive OEMs
Related party concentration with ultimate holding company
Compliance risk with past BSE fines for procedural non-compliances
Market risk in equity share price
facts.related_party_note: Significant transactions with ultimate holding company Jujhar Constructions and Travels Private Limited: sale of services Rs. 1,247.45 Lakh and purchase of goods Rs. 1,128.40 Lakh, each exceeding 10% of consolidated turnover (Rs. 748.78 Lakh). All transactions on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business.
